caption: The map f only writes M′ down; it never runs it. All inputs except 101 are rejected straight away, so M′ accepts something exactly when M accepts w — which is why a decider for B would decide A_TM.

spec.title: The machine M′ that f builds, for B = {⟨M⟩ : M accepts 101}
spec.aria: A downward flow for the built machine M′: it reads input x, checks whether x is the word 101 (at most three symbol comparisons); if not it rejects at once, and if yes it simulates M on w, accepting when M accepts w and running forever when M does not.
